newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia stocks ease, Hansapank most traded.
newsitem.headline: Estonia stocks ease, Hansapank most traded.

text.p: Trading in Estonian shares eased on Friday with the market moving lower and index falling while leading bank Hansapank was the most traded share, dealers said.

The official list volume came to 19.8 million kroons, with the index falling by 0.32 percent to 160.66. Shares in Hansapank turned over 11.6 million kroons and closed lower at 162.25 kroons against 162.80.
Estonia's second largest bank Savings Bank had volume of 4.3 million kroons and closed 2.10 kroons higher at 67.50 kroons.
Forekspank turned over 2.4 million kroons to close lower at 122.25 kroons against 122.60.

The over-the-counter market volume was some 5.5 million kroons and Tallinna Kaubamaja department store was the most active. It turned over 3.7 million kroons but closed lower at 75.75 kroons against 76.52.
